items.stem: Which TWO practices support responsible use of Gemini in Docs with sensitive material? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Follow your organisation's data-handling policy before using confidential files
options.rationale: Correct: confidential content is still governed by data policy.

options.text: Disclose where AI assistance was used in the final document
options.rationale: Correct: disclosure supports transparency and review.

options.text: Assume all generated claims are verified
Share drafts publicly to get faster output
options.rationale: Public sharing does not speed generation and risks exposure.

items.explanation: Correct: following data policy and disclosing AI assistance are both responsible practices.
